name: Power Gem
notes: Power Gem: +10% damage for all the player's moves, up to 5 times (+50%). Adds 10 to boost_power (the same boost the classic run's floor Power Gem gives). Offered on the waves mode's level-up menu (menu_power); its level is kept in 'up_power' (back to 0 each run).
